panel.title: 📬 Monroe County Ticket System
panel.description:
Need assistance or looking to partner? Click one of the buttons below to open a private ticket.

🎮 **Game Report** — In-game bugs, glitches & server issues
🎫 **Support Ticket** — General questions & server support
🚨 **Player Report** — Player violations & rule breaches
🤝 **Partnership** — Server partnerships & collaborations

*Our staff team will assist you as soon as possible.*
panel.footer: Monroe County Support • Click a button below to open a ticket

ticketTypes.label: Game Report
ticketTypes.welcomeDescription:
Thank you for reaching out! Please describe the game issue, bug, or glitch you encountered in detail.
Provide screenshots or video evidence if available.

A staff member will claim and assist you shortly.

ticketTypes.label: Support Ticket
ticketTypes.welcomeDescription:
Welcome to your support ticket! Please explain what you need assistance with.

A staff member will claim and assist you shortly.

ticketTypes.label: Player Report
ticketTypes.welcomeDescription:
Thank you for submitting a report. Please provide:
• Offending Player's Name / ID
• Description of rule broken
• Time / Date of incident
• Proof / Evidence (Screenshots/Clips)

A staff member will claim and review this report shortly.

ticketTypes.label: Partnership
ticketTypes.welcomeDescription:
Welcome to Monroe County Partnerships! Please provide:
• Your Server / Community Name
• Member Count
• Permanent Discord Invite Link
• Server Representative / Contact

Our Public Relations / Management team will review your partnership request shortly.
